partition.description: partition types (building blocks, user 2026-11-04): every partition is one block (chip) of a type with its own CPU (DMIPS), RAM and ROM (kB, the units of the v3 demands), TOPS and price; the solver chooses the type of every partition, any mix of up to site.max_partitions blocks per cell, one ASIL per partition, every block supports every ASIL. TOPS is a block resource: the accelerator requirement tops_feature (HW_ACC) is served by the TOPS of the component's block (no add-on accelerator). Capacities and prices from configs/unit_classes.json (class), chip price only, external memory not priced. max_per_asil_per_site null = no limit of its own (user 2026-11-04).

site.description: Caps and fixed activation cost of the control unit at a cell (the single unit size of configs/vehicle.json installation_space.ecu_size): at most max_partitions partitions, and the hosted demand of the whole unit (sum over all its partitions, with the demand margins and hot standbys, as in the partition capacity constraint) at most cpu/ram/rom_cap times the site derating (same units as the partition capacities). null = unlimited, fixed_cost 0 = free. Provisional values 2026-10-20 (two partitions' worth of compute, four partitions) until the data pass. switch_node_cost (2026-10-30): the same unit cost for a cell that holds only a switch and no software (its own housing, supply and mounting); 0 = the switch chip only (hardwares.json), the model before 2026-10-30.
site.cost_source: no housing cost per cell (user 2026-11-04: 'there should be no such cost')

_v3: partition types of the schema-v3 instances (tools/arch_v3_prepare.py BLOCK_CLASSES): S32K344 (ecu_small), TC397 (zone_mcu_classic), S32G3 (zone_gateway), TDA4VH (central_ad_soc_ti), ORIN (central_ad_gpu); a cell = up to 4 blocks, no per-cell resource caps, no housing cost
